text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — running a 'seatbelt' validation for TitanCorp reserved pool tomorrow 11:00 PST. Objective: verify quota mapping, autoscaler behavior, and load scripts before Friday cutover. Need SRE + Platform + SE.

sam_sre: On it. What are autoscale thresholds (min/max/step)?

maria_cs: Proposed: min=2, target=8, max=12, step=+2, cooldown=120s. Anticipate bursts ~6k RPS for 10m windows.

lee_platform: Noted. I'll recheck node boot times — saw ~65s from idle in staging. If cold-start exceeds 90s, recommend min=3.

olivia_se: TitanCorp expects <200ms p95 on simple prompts. That's aggressive for the planned qps; we'll demo fallback routing to quantized variant.

maria_cs: Add fallback route to runbook: redwood-small-q4. Also include customer-facing note about potential SLA delta in first 24h.

taylor_ops: What load profile? paste the k6 snippet pls.

sam_sre: k6 snippet: 

```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood/test-gen', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'short'}), {tags:{stage:'seatbelt'}});
}
```
Ramping 100 -> 6k RPS over 6m, hold 10m, drop 30s. Concurrency ~1200.

maria_cs: Also run KV-cache priming: 10k short prompts across keyspace to warm caches.

lee_platform: Will run priming before main. Question: quota enforcement — per-account bucket or pool-level?

olivia_se: They bought a dedicated quota pool. Configure per-account committed=5000, burst=7000, leak_smoothing=60s.

sam_sre: I'll patch staging quota and post diff.

k8s-bot: deployment scheduled: reserved-pool/titancorp seatbelt-2024-05-04T11:00Z -> staging cluster-3

maria_cs: Ops checklist:
- KV priming 09:50
- apply quota patch 10:10
- smoke 10:30 (10m @200 RPS)
- main seatbelt 11:00 (ramp to 6k)
- post-run evals + log sweep 12:30

sam_sre: Monitoring hooks:
- dashboard /dash/pools/titancorp (token breakdown, latency p50/p95/p99, GPU util)
- alert: sustained p95 > 800ms for 2m -> notify #eng-oncall + sam_sre
- fallback trigger: >=15% errors or p95 > 1s for 3m -> route 20% to redwood-small-q4

olivia_se: Leaving renewal note: if seatbelt shows instability mark as potential renewal risk. Option: offer 2-week grace on committed charges if migration impacts throughput.

maria_cs: Capture as option B. SE to record gaps in post-run notes and product sign-off required for credits.

taylor_ops: Can we simulate degraded nodes? Drop 2 nodes mid-run to test autoscale recovery.

lee_platform: Will schedule a kill at T+7m. Autoscaler should add nodes within cooldown if headroom allows. Preparing chaos step.

maria_cs: Please record dashboard clips during run for TitanCorp postmortem.

olivia_se: I'll capture demo video and add a 3-question post-demo survey link for feedback.

sam_sre: Quota diff posted: https://git.internal/r/quota/commit/ae34f2 (staging). Review before 10:00.

maria_cs: Invite out in 5. Ping here for blockers. :seatbelt: :white_check_mark:

lee_platform: No infra blockers.

k8s-bot: run started (priming) 2024-05-04T09:50:12Z

maria_cs: Post-run placeholder — will paste results after 12:30.

sam_sre: Post-run: GPU util peaked 92%, p95 320ms at steady 5k RPS. Autoscaler grew 2->10 nodes within ~140s after chaos injection. KV priming cut cold-starts ~70%.

olivia_se: Customer feedback: liked dashboard, asked for sub-50ms p50 on simple prompts — logged as product ask. Appreciated fallback demo.

maria_cs: Summary for renewal: seatbelt successful; minor jitter during T+7m chaos but autoscale recovered. Recommend proceed with cutover; offer 1-week credit if regressions in first 72h.

taylor_ops: ACK — closing cookthrough and moving notes to playbooks/titancorp-seatbelt-2024-05.json

k8s-bot: ticket #CS-4729 updated: seatbelt run completed
